summary: Derma Medical Center has a clear offer, a booking form and WhatsApp. But visible errors on the page weaken trust right where a patient decides to book.

findings.problem: The stat counters (Incredible doctors, Years of combined experience, Happy patients) read 0, next to 1 location and 3 doctors. Two images use the Elementor placeholder file.
findings.cost: Zeros and placeholder images make a medical clinic look unfinished at the exact moment a patient is judging it.
findings.fix: Real numbers or no counters, and real clinic photos.

findings.problem: The WhatsApp buttons use your landline (+971 2 444 5112), while the chat link uses a different mobile number.
findings.cost: A patient who taps WhatsApp on a landline gets no reply, and the booking is lost without you knowing.
findings.fix: One WhatsApp number used consistently, with a pre-filled message per treatment.

findings.problem: The 4.8 rating from 1000+ reviews has no source and no review text. There are no before and after cases, and the doctor videos are unlabelled links.
findings.cost: Patients choose a clinic on visible proof. Claims without proof do not persuade.
findings.fix: A review wall pulled from your real Google reviews and captioned results.

findings.problem: The booking form lists Facial, Body, Laser and Injectables but omits Plastic Surgery and Non-Surgical, and the booking anchors may not exist. Derma Medical Centre and Center are mixed.
findings.cost: Patients interested in your higher value services cannot choose them, and inconsistent names look careless.
findings.fix: A form that matches every service, tested end to end.

redesign: A proof first homepage: real reviews, results and your licence beside every booking button.
One working booking path plus WhatsApp on the right number, so a patient books in under 30 seconds.
Treatment pages written to rank for searches like laser hair removal Abu Dhabi and Botox Abu Dhabi.
